scenariocompass_checker

Source: R/scenario_compass_evaluation.R
scenariocompass_checker.Rd

Assess scenario run against Scenario Compass Criteria. Evaluates a standardized reporting dataset to determine feasibility and sustainability outcomes based on the Scenario Compass frameworks (more info at https://scenario-evaluation-criteria.iamconsortium.org/.)

Usage

scenariocompass_checker(
  report,
  desired_scenarios = NULL,
  desired_regions = NULL,
  GCAM_version = "v8.2",
  save_output = TRUE,
  output_file = NULL
)

Arguments

report

A data frame containing the standardized report (e.g., output from `generate_report()`), or a character string representing the file path to a saved report. Supported file extensions: `.csv`, `.xlsx`, and `.RData`.

desired_scenarios

A character vector of specific scenarios to assess. If `NULL` (the default), all scenarios present in `report` are evaluated.

desired_regions

A character vector of specific regions to assess. If `NULL` (the default), all regions present in the report are evaluated. You can provide `'World'` for a global assessment, `'Regional'` to evaluate all sub-regions, or explicitly list specific GCAM region names. Run `available_regions()` to see the complete list of supported options.

GCAM_version

A character string specifying the GCAM version used for regional mappings and reference datasets (e.g., `'v8.2'`). Run `available_GCAM_versions()` to see the complete list of supported options.

save_output

Logical (`TRUE`/`FALSE`). Determines whether the resulting assessment should be saved to disk. Defaults to `TRUE`.

output_file

A character string specifying the absolute or relative file path for the saved output. If `NULL` and `save_output` is enabled, it defaults to the `report` file path (if present) or is set to the current working directory.

Value

A data frame containing the evaluation outcomes (`ok`, `medium`, `high`, `failed`, or `not_assigned`) for the assessed variables and regions. If `save_output` is enabled, the dataset is also saved to disk.
